name: inphyni_lapalma
label: INPHYNI large-area time-tag detector for La Palma (2027)
sources: R. Kaiser (INPHYNI), email to P. Nugent 2026-11-09 ('Targets La Palma'): 1 nm filter at 417 nm (or 431 nm), 2 channels (two polarizations) per telescope, 20 % detection efficiency (large-area detectors, no fibre coupling), 35 ps rms jitter including TDC, detector and synchronization; ready for early 2027
R. Kaiser, e-mail 2026-11-10 ('Targets La Palma'): the detectors' limitation is in integrated counts, not in maximum count rate.
notes: jitter_fwhm_ps 82.4 = 2.355 x 35 ps rms (Gaussian), taken as the single-detector value (the pair response is then 49.5 ps rms); if the 35 ps is already the pair's resolution the S/N is 1.19x higher. One entry per polarization channel: the backends use polarization_mode pbs (two detectors per telescope, half the flux and full contrast each, added in quadrature).

No count-rate ceiling (max_total_cps null): R. Kaiser, e-mail 2026-11-10, says their limit is in integrated counts, not in rate. Runs before 2026-11-10 ASSUMED a 10 Mcps ceiling, which throttled the GTC by 1.4-2.4x.
Dead time and dark rate are not supplied: ASSUMED (the Calern SNSPD values).
